summary: La Rosa Holdings filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, reporting a September 28, 2026 Section 3(a)(9) exchange agreement with certain holders. Holders exchanged $1.5 million principal of an $11 million senior secured convertible note plus related interest, all 100 Series C, 500 Series D, and 810 Series E preferred shares for 3,410 new Series F convertible preferred shares. The canceled securities are void, and the company must hold a stockholder meeting within 45 days to approve conversion share issuance. A Nasdaq-listed real estate firm, La Rosa structurally simplified its capital stack and deferred equity conversion pending approval. Watch for conversion pricing, dilution, and whether the remaining $9.5 million note exchanges similarly.
